cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Not Dismissed
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by treating departure as a privilege only you can grant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before you put your coat on, I'd like to formally conclude our coffee. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only stopped for ten minutes. My bus is due.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then I'll consider an early departure. Sit down while I decide.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The café's closing. They've asked us both to leave.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. We'll wait outside together. Their permission to leave doesn't replace mine.

mechanism: A controls the formal end of a coffee visit but follows B toward the bus and accepts the cafe closing boundary while still treating departure as A grant.
confusable: Unlike ordinary farewell delay, A insists permission remains necessary; confidence depends on keeping the leaving friend engaged rather than compelling obedience.
comparison: A social bus deadline and shared cafe eviction differ from a shop closing dismissal and waiting child.
seedUse: Use D50-b coffee/bus/cafe-close structure and S02-a claiming a concession as controlled process.
